evidence: The paper uses "hierarchical k-means clustering of 33 histologic variables" and random forests solely for missing-value imputation via missRanger. Variable selection for the prognostic model uses "univariate Bayesian generalized linear models to identify variables for the final multivariate model," with statistical significance determined by p-values from these Bayesian models, not by random-forest impurity importance. The three prognostic factors (remyelination p=0.006, fiber-invasive infiltrates p=0.022, intramuscular fiber loss p=0.045) are reported as univariate and multivariate model estimates, not as ranked importance scores.
